svg.aria-label: The system on Docker Desktop Kubernetes in Phase 2
svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.tspan: Phase 2 | Helm chart -> Traefik Gateway -> 9 Go services -> KEDA scaling on queue depth
your repo - everything Kubernetes lives here
one chart, used by every service
single node - the same manifests later run on Amazon EKS
namespace: ticketdrop - one Helm chart, nine releases
Every pod: probes and metrics on :9090 - non-root, read-only filesystem
web, gateway, catalog, orders and inventory also serve on :8080
Pod Security: restricted - NetworkPolicy: deny by default
